sentences.text: A straight line through data is the simplest model that learns.
sentences.say: A straight line through data is the simplest model that learns.

sentences.text: Logistic regression, neural networks and even LLMs are variations on it, so understand this one fully.
sentences.say: Logistic regression, neural networks and even LLMs are variations on it, so understand this one fully.

sentences.text: Key ideas
sentences.say: Key ideas

sentences.text: The model is f(x) = w x + b. The weight w is the slope and the bias b is the value at x = 0.
sentences.say: The model is f(x) equals w x plus b. The weight w is the slope and the bias b is the value at x equals 0.

sentences.text: "Best line" has to be defined.
sentences.say: "Best line" has to be defined.

sentences.text: The usual definition: the line that makes the squared gaps to the points as small as possible.
sentences.say: The usual definition: the line that makes the squared gaps to the points as small as possible.

sentences.text: You can find that line in one step with a formula (least squares), or step by step with gradient descent (Chapter 6).
sentences.say: You can find that line in one step with a formula (least squares), or step by step with gradient descent (Chapter 6).

sentences.text: With one input feature the model is called univariate linear regression.
sentences.say: With one input feature the model is called univariate linear regression.

sentences.text: 4.1 The model
sentences.say: 4.1 The model

sentences.text: Ng's running example predicts a house price from its size, using 47 houses from Portland.
sentences.say: Ng's running example predicts a house price from its size, using 47 houses from Portland.

sentences.text: Plot size on the horizontal axis and price on the vertical axis, and the points rise to the right.
sentences.say: Plot size on the horizontal axis and price on the vertical axis, and the points rise to the right.

sentences.text: Draw a line through them and you can read off a price for any size: his client's 1,250 square foot house comes out at about $250,000.
sentences.say: Draw a line through them and you can read off a price for any size: his client's 1,250 square foot house comes out at about $250,000.

sentences.text: x is the input (size), and f(x), written y-hat, is the prediction (price).
sentences.say: x is the input (size), and f(x), written y-hat, is the prediction (price).

sentences.text: w (weight, slope, coefficient): how much the prediction rises when x rises by 1.
sentences.say: w (weight, slope, coefficient): how much the prediction rises when times rises by 1.

sentences.text: b (bias, intercept): the prediction when x is 0.
sentences.say: b (bias, intercept): the prediction when times is 0.

sentences.text: With w = 0.2 thousand dollars per square foot and b = 0, a 1,250 square foot house gives 1,250 x 0.2 = 250, which is $250,000.
sentences.say: With w equals 0.2 thousand dollars per square foot and b equals 0, a 1,250 square foot house gives 1,250 times 0.2 equals 250, which is $250,000.

sentences.text: Different values of w and b give different lines, and training is the search for the best pair.
sentences.say: Different values of w and b give different lines, and training is the search for the best pair.

sentences.text: 4.2 What "best" means
sentences.say: 4.2 What "best" means

sentences.text: A line can pass close to some points and far from others.
sentences.say: A line can pass close to some points and far from others.

sentences.text: To compare lines you need one number that says how far a line is from all the points together.
sentences.say: To compare lines you need one number that says how far a line is from all the points together.

sentences.text: The recipe (Infinite Codes asks you to put each formula into words like this):
sentences.say: The recipe (Infinite Codes asks you to put each formula into words like this):

sentences.text: For one point, the error is the prediction minus the true value: f(x) - y.
sentences.say: For one point, the error is the prediction minus the true value: f(x) minus y.

sentences.text: Square it, so that errors above and below the line both count as positive, and big misses count much more than small ones.
sentences.say: Square it, so that errors above and below the line both count as positive, and big misses count much more than small ones.

sentences.text: Add up the squares over all points.
sentences.say: Add up the squares over all points.

sentences.text: Take three points (1, 1), (2, 2) and (3, 3).
sentences.say: Take three points (1, 1), (2, 2) and (3, 3).

sentences.text: The line with w = 1 and b = 0 passes through all three: every error is 0.
sentences.say: The line with w equals 1 and b equals 0 passes through all three: every error is 0.

sentences.text: The line with w = 0.5 and b = 0 predicts 0.5, 1 and 1.5, so the errors are -0.5, -1 and -1.5.
sentences.say: The line with w equals 0.5 and b equals 0 predicts 0.5, 1 and 1.5, so the errors are -0.5, -1 and -1.5.

sentences.text: Squared and added, that is 0.25 + 1 + 2.25 = 3.5.
sentences.say: Squared and added, that is 0.25 plus 1 plus 2.25 equals 3.5.

sentences.text: The first line is clearly better, and the number says so.
sentences.say: The first line is clearly better, and the number says so.

sentences.text: Beyond the videos.
sentences.say: Beyond the videos.

sentences.text: Interpolation is safe, extrapolation is not.
sentences.say: Interpolation is safe, extrapolation is not.

sentences.text: The line is only trustworthy inside the range of sizes it saw.
sentences.say: The line is only trustworthy inside the range of sizes it saw.

sentences.text: A line fitted to houses between 300 and 2,000 square feet says little about a 10,000 square foot mansion.
sentences.say: A line fitted to houses between 300 and 2,000 square feet says little about a 10,000 square foot mansion.

sentences.text: Correlation is not causation.
sentences.say: Correlation is not causation.

sentences.text: A good fit tells you that size and price move together, not that making a house bigger would raise its value by the slope.
sentences.say: A good fit tells you that size and price move together, not that making a house bigger would raise its value by the slope.

sentences.text: Mind the units.
sentences.say: Mind the units.

sentences.text: If x is in square feet and y in thousands of dollars, w is in thousands of dollars per square foot.
sentences.say: If times is in square feet and y in thousands of dollars, w is in thousands of dollars per square foot.

sentences.text: Predict the monthly cost of an offer from the offered amount.

sentences.text: A fitted model might look like f(amount) = 0.029 x amount + 8 (invented numbers).

sentences.text: Then a 10,000 euro offer is predicted at 0.029 x 10,000 + 8 = 298 euros per month.
